description: NaSr₂Nb₅O₁₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmm2 space group. Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.55 Å) and two longer (2.70 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-3.20 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.65-2.96 Å. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-47°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.22 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-39°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.22 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-34°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.26 Å. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-38°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.24 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Sr and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Sr and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Sr and two Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and two Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Sr and two equivalent Nb atoms.
